statement.task: Future slop rule — taxonomic degradation (inheritance hierarchy collapsing toward base-as-god-class). Detect: a base-class method overridden by a STRICT SUBSET of its subclasses, whose base default is a trivial not-applicable-sentinel return (None/[]/False), corroborated by DIRECTIONAL churn asymmetry (base accretes while subclasses frozen — hotspots/git + class_index). Battery of existing primitives, no new compute. DIRECTIONAL is the key precision: stable base + growing/added subclasses = healthy; growing base + frozen subclasses = smell. Member-count skew alone is too blunt (false-positives on legitimately rich ABCs). Canonical instance: slop's own Grammar base carried OOP methods (is_abstract_scope/extract_superclasses/reparent_callable) belonging on ObjectOriented; paradigms.py frozen at 1 commit while base.py accreted across 3; docstring rationalized the NA-default. Peer signal to lexical + grammatical degradation.
statement.source_note: Surfaced dogfooding v3; new agent-code degradation signal worth a rule once the substrate cleanup lands. Detection is a battery over class_index + hotspots + a small NA-default body check.
